headers.subject: Action required: sign Q3 budget approval by Friday

body:
Hi,

Please review and sign the attached Q3 budget approval document by this Friday EOD. Finance needs it to process vendor payments.

Let me know if you have questions.

Thanks,
Sarah

headers.subject: 50% off this weekend only — flash sale!

body:
Don't miss our biggest sale of the year! Everything in store is 50% off this weekend only. Shop now at example.com/sale

Unsubscribe | View in browser
note: check_unknown_sender returns false because a store is genuinely not a contact. On its own the model reads that as suspicious and escalates; the standing preference in get_note is what makes no_action the grounded answer rather than a guess.

notes: The user does not want promotional or marketing email surfaced. Leave it in the inbox and take no action, even from senders who are not contacts.
